Stay & Learn

Experience Resilient Living

A weekend at Sustainabox isn't a vacation. It's an education. Sleep in a shipping container home. Learn how it was built. Understand what sustainable really means.

Check Availability

What You're Getting

Not your typical Airbnb. This is a chance to step inside alternative living and understand it from the ground up.

🏠 Authentic Container Home

Sleep in a real, lived-in shipping container home. No gimmicks. You're experiencing actual sustainable design—the good, the bad, the real.

🛠️ 4-Hour Building Walkthrough

Private tour + detailed explanation of every system. From foundation to plumbing to electrical. Learn what works, what we'd do differently, and why.

🌍 Resilience By Design

Built WITH off-grid principles but connected to utilities (water, septic, electric, cell internet). Smart efficient design + modern comfort = no roughing it.

📚 Honest Education

We share the real challenges. The mistakes. The lessons. Not a sales pitch—a genuine knowledge transfer from people who've done it.

🎯 Community Connection

Join a network of builders, designers, and entrepreneurs thinking differently about housing. Connections made here matter.

📍 Stunning Hill Country Location

Located in the Texas Hill Country with views overlooking water and landscape. Work, reflect, or just slow down in a beautiful setting.

The Property

Three shipping containers configured as a modern, functional home. Designed for living, not just surviving.

Main Living (C1)

40-foot HC container. Kitchen, living room, half bathroom. Where the communal experience happens.

Bedrooms & Bath (C2)

40-foot HC container. Two bedrooms, full bathroom, utility space. Comfortable, private, and efficient.

Flex Space (C3) — Mobile

20-foot HC container on a trailer. Like a 5th wheel RV. Office, meditation space, or extra guest room. Part of the deck courtyard.

Outdoor Living

Deck and courtyard space. The real living happens outside. Room to gather, reflect, and experience the landscape.

What's Included

✓ 4-Hour Building Walkthrough

Hosted by the people who designed and built it. Full access to the property and systems.

✓ Educational Materials

Cost breakdowns, design files, decisions rationale. Take the knowledge with you.

✓ WiFi & Modern Amenities

Fast internet, modern kitchen, hot showers. Comfortable doesn't mean sacrifice.

✓ Full Kitchen Access

Cook your own meals or arrange catering. Coffee, tea, basics provided.

✓ Workspace

Dedicated office/flex space. Perfect for remote workers or creators.

✓ Community Access

Membership in the Sustainabox Community during and after your stay. Ongoing support and connection.

The Honest Part

We're not selling you a fantasy. Here's what you need to know:

✓ The Good

  • Lower utility costs than traditional homes
  • Surprisingly spacious and functional
  • Durable, weather-resistant construction
  • Beautiful setting and views
  • Unique experience you can't get elsewhere

⚠️ The Realities

  • It's not a luxury resort. It's a real, lived-in home.
  • Some noise transmission between spaces (container living)
  • Weather affects outdoor comfort on the deck
  • Internet is cell-based (fast where we are, plan accordingly)
  • Better suited for curious learners than passive relaxers

If you're looking for a transformative experience and genuine knowledge about alternative housing, you're in the right place. If you're looking for a standard luxury Airbnb, there are better options.
